03 / FROM THE HEART

A LETTER FOR YOU

Dear Doddy,

On the day you turn 18, yaa Doddy, I’m very glad to be with you on this special day. It makes me remember the last birthday we had together. It was one of the best days of my life. Every single detail still makes me laugh and fall more deeply in love with you.

And I wasn’t cold at the cinema tho 🥀. For real, holding your hand that time flashes through my mind every day ❤️.

We had too many problems this year, but we’re still together — this time and forever. I’m so proud of you and all your achievements. I don’t know if we’ll go out today or not, so I can’t say what we’re going to do, but I really want to go to a photobooth with youuu 😍.

I love you more than anything, and more than you think.

Happy 18th, ya Doddy. ❤️

With all my love,Mahmoud♡
